top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs Katori's magic-wavelength lattice idea with Ye's realisation at 10^-18, confirmed in direct comparisons between independent laboratories (JILA, RIKEN, PTB, NIST, SYRTE). It has a clean two-name credit that no member disputes and a citation that can be kept to the lattice clock without re-awarding the 2005 comb or 2012 single-ion prizes. P004 adds the same part plus a sole-credit IceCube part that I find scientifically real but weaker on credit and source identification, so it ranks second. P002 is exciting but less mature on pairing mechanism and credit; P003 is a narrow technique-level award; no award is last because a mature, reproduced achievement is available.
recusal_note: Possible mild connection: I am an astroparticle experimentalist in the same broad community as the IceCube part of P004 (cosmic-ray and gamma-ray instrumentation), but no direct collaboration is apparent from my profile; none apparent for the other proposals.
